study type: Retrospective analysis of birth certificate records
cohort: Births in California between 1991 and 2011 (10,593,904 deliveries)
finding: After declining from 1991 to 2004, out-of-hospital births increased in California from 2005 to 2011, with a concurrent increase in vaginal birth after cesarean in this group.
mod_finding: The frequency of vaginal birth after cesarean in the out-of-hospital birth cohort increased from 1.2% (n=19) in 1996 to 4.2% (n=82) in 2011.
